column5: And oh so happy that they were being showered with praise!
A death defying stunt should be terrifying, heart racing, dreadful to see.
And yet, with hard work, with effort, with courage,
the clown was able to make people laugh; no longer were they afraid.
To take what many would never consider to be a so-called ‘laughing matter’ and make it so.
A skill so wonderful: it truly encompasses a comic, a clown, a performer.
And what am I, if not that? A mask that one performs behind to make others laugh?
And what am I, if I cannot do the same?
So there must be a trick, a way to turn their effort, their hard-work…
Some trick to change what many would never call a ‘laughing matter’, into something that people may laugh at?
And what a wonderful trick I have.
